scenes.headline: How xHC widens the residual stream to sixteen
scenes.sub: Read every stream, mix and write only four
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Huckleberry! A Transformer carries one vector per token. xHC carries sixteen, and writes four at a time.

scenes.text: Keep mHC's doubly stochastic mixing, but run it on four routed streams per sublayer, read all sixteen, and give each write four directions instead of one.
scenes.say: Keep mHC's doubly stochastic mixing on four routed streams, read all sixteen, and give each write four directions.

left.title: mHC, dense mixing
items: Every stream mixed at every sublayer
Mixing generator grows as N cubed
left.say: mHC mixes every stream every sublayer, writes one vector, and its mixing cost grows as the stream count cubed.

right.title: xHC, sparse mixing
items: Four routed streams mixed per sublayer
Four write directions after each MLP
Mixing cost set by four, not sixteen
right.say: xHC mixes four routed streams, writes four directions after each MLP, and pays for four.

steps.say: Each token carries sixteen streams. A dense read sums them, and the layer runs on that one vector.
A router picks four: two always on, two by score. Only those four are mixed, by Sinkhorn.
After an MLP, causal convolutions over the last four, eight and twelve tokens add three more directions.
The write lands on the four active streams. The other twelve pass through untouched.

scenes.title: The update for the active streams
scenes.text: X_new = H_res X_act + p H_post out_aug

parts.note: a doubly stochastic mix: rows and columns sum to one
parts.say: The mix is doubly stochastic, and the other twelve streams keep the identity, so the full map is too.

parts.note: four write directions, not one vector
parts.say: The write has four components: rank four, where mHC writes rank one.

parts.note: the router weight gates the write, never the mix
parts.say: The router's weight gates only the write, never the mix.

steps.note: mHC from 4 to 16 streams: loss down 0.006, FLOPs up 32%
steps.say: In the paper's sweep, mHC flattens after four streams for a third more compute.

steps.note: xHC from 4 to 16 streams: loss down 0.012, FLOPs up 4%
steps.say: xHC keeps falling to sixteen, for about four percent more.

scenes.title: Average of 12 benchmarks, 18B MoE
scenes.note: Single runs. At 28B the lead over mHC shrinks to 3.1
scenes.say: At eighteen billion parameters the average rises from forty-four point eight to forty-eight point eight. At twenty-eight billion the lead shrinks.

scenes.text: Keep the mixing doubly stochastic but sparse: read every stream, mix and write a few, and make each write richer.

recap: Read all sixteen streams, write four
The Sinkhorn bound holds on every sublayer
scenes.say: To recap: read everything, write a few, keep the bound.
